entries.065211014d5aa8ac: This field mainly involves contract work on back-office system maintenance, such as operation and maintenance of systems using cloud for banks and securities companies, environment construction for systems linking multiple tasks, and design of mechanisms to strengthen access restrictions to bank servers. It specializes in developing information systems that support sales and other operations based on transactions. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥547 million.

entries.14ff92003d3043a1: A field in which it accepts contracts to build infrastructure platforms and migrate systems provided by cloud service operators, and to develop article layout systems for major publishers and contract and billing management systems for major providers. In recent years it has expanded the scope of its contracts to DX investment projects of large companies, such as the renewal and integration of major EC sites and the integration of department store point services. Sales results for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥1,720 million.
entries.1616445f881a1466: This field involves contract development of unique functions and new services for major telecommunications carriers, received from carriers or major IT vendors. The company continuously takes on development related to carriers' core technologies, including support for the evolution of Short Message Service, support for 5G, RADIUS authentication, location information notification and search systems, telematics systems for commercial vehicles, and infrastructure construction for corporate network construction services. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥706 million.

entries.68a828056029ac02: This field develops systems for government agencies and public infrastructure, mainly through contract development from major IT vendors. The company is involved in electronic application systems for local governments, benefit payment claim reception systems from nursing care facilities, subsidy application systems for local governments, and voting reception and inquiry systems for public racing. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥713 million.

entries.9334b3c0b77bc359: This field develops software and applications built into industrial equipment and in-vehicle equipment using IoT technology. The company works on software for next-generation meter panels and car navigation systems, systems that manage measurement values of medical devices, and firmware for industrial measuring instruments. Consolidated subsidiary Chishiki Kogaku Co., Ltd. specializes in manufacturing, including control applications for chemical analysis equipment. The company also operates its in-house developed business chat service "ChatCo!" in this field. Sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥1,060 million.
